name: Sorcerer Meteor strike

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: orange danger disc fades in on the ground, ember motes rise, sky darkens slightly

phases.name: release
phases.what: fire rock streaks down at a steep angle with a long tail

phases.name: impact
phases.what: white flash, ring blast, debris and fire geyser

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: burning crater glows, smoke column and embers drift

layers.motion: radius grows 0.6 to 1 over 0.9s, pulsing edge
layers.notes: sharp bright rim so the safe edge reads instantly
dark rock body with emissive cracks so it reads against fire

layers.motion: ribbon follows rock, width tapers over 0.5s
layers.notes: long tail sells speed and shows the approach angle
one or two frame white hit

layers.motion: flat ring expands to danger radius in 0.4s
layers.notes: matches the telegraph radius so damage feels honest

layers.motion: radial burst upward, gravity 14, tumble, 30 pieces
layers.notes: dark chunks give contrast to the glowing fire
dark smoke behind bright layers adds depth
long lived embers carry the afterglow

whyItLooksGood: telegraph first, then a long streak lets the eye follow the fall
white-hot flash to dark smoke gives a strong value ladder
ring radius equals the danger disc
buildNotes: Build the danger disc as a flat ring plus filled additive disc with a pulsing rim. Fall the rock from 40 units up with ease-in over 0.5s. Exaggerate: double the debris count, add a light pillar of fire for 0.3s, leave a glowing crater decal with groundFade for 4s.

name: Radahn gravity leap impact

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: swords stabbed into ground, purple-blue gravity sparks crawl over him, ground darkens

phases.name: release
phases.what: he launches out of sight, only a rising streak and light remain

phases.name: impact
phases.what: he falls back, huge blast and shockwave

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: dust cloud and gravity motes settle

layers.motion: slow rotation, scales up as he charges
layers.notes: arcane circle at the landing point warns of the strike
pulled inward motes read as gravity

layers.motion: dark circle grows to landing radius
two rings, 0.6s and 0.9s, fast then slow
layers.notes: double ring reads as heavy mass
chunks lift slowly then slam down

layers.motion: radial dust ring then drift, erosion
layers.notes: dust ring low to the floor

whyItLooksGood: the vanishing beat builds dread before the landing
dark landing disc is a clear danger zone
violet energy against brown dust gives hue contrast
buildNotes: Hide the character during the gap and keep a small rising light so the player knows where to look. On the way down scale a violet glow sphere at the target point. Exaggerate: add a second delayed ring and a vertical violet pillar on impact.

name: Elementalist Meteor Shower

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: fire sigil circle draws on the ground, red glow

phases.name: release
phases.what: many small meteors fall at random spots in the circle

phases.name: impact
phases.what: each meteor makes a small blast and scorch

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: last embers and smoke fade

layers.notes: circle stays for the whole duration so the zone stays readable
keep low alpha so impacts show on top
scale small so many hits stay legible

whyItLooksGood: persistent circle gives a clear area while chaos happens inside
many small hits give rhythm
dark rocks against fire keep each hit visible
buildNotes: Use instanced meshes for rocks and a single emitter for hit sparks. Randomise impact positions with a slight bias to the centre. Exaggerate: raise count to 40, add point light flashes per hit and short camera shake pulses.

name: Titan Weight of the Land circles

source.title: FFXIV - The Navel Extreme (Titan, mechanic page)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: orange circle telegraphs appear under players and fill from the edge

phases.name: release
phases.what: ground cracks and rock spikes surge up

phases.name: impact
phases.what: dust and rock burst, hit flash

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: dust falls, cracked decal remains

layers.motion: outline first, inner fill grows from edge to centre over 2s
layers.notes: fill progress tells timing; this is the key readable part
keeps telegraph visible on any floor

layers.motion: spikes shoot up 0.15s, 8 per circle, then fall

whyItLooksGood: clear fill timing during telegraph
impact ends exactly at the circle edge
earth colours separate it from fire spells
buildNotes: Build the telegraph as a ring plus a filled disc whose radius is animated with a shader uniform or a scaled disc. Use a normal-blend dark underlay. Exaggerate: add more rock spikes, a bright rim at completion, and lingering cracks with groundFade.

name: Bahamut Megaflare circles

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: big red circles mark the ground, fiery orbs gather above

phases.name: release
phases.what: orbs fall as columns

phases.name: impact
phases.what: huge white-orange explosions

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: fire pools and smoke

layers.motion: large circles, edge pulse faster as time runs out
orb above each circle grows 0.2 to 1.2
column drops in 0.15s, width = circle radius 0.5

whyItLooksGood: stack of circles reads as pattern puzzle
pulse speed gives timing without UI
white column vs dark red ground gives high contrast
buildNotes: Instance circle decals from a small pool. Drive the pulse with sin(time*rate) where rate rises. Exaggerate: overlap three waves of circles, a ground shake on each, and a huge sky glow.

name: Sorceress Doomsday meteor

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: sorceress raises staff, magic circle on target and red glow in sky

phases.name: release
phases.what: giant meteor descends with trailing flame

phases.name: impact
phases.what: explosion with fire ring

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: flames and smoke on ground

layers.motion: sky glow spawns at 20 units up

whyItLooksGood: sigil + sky glow warns the area
big meteor scale in relation to caster
smoke contrasts with bright blast
buildNotes: Use a large additive glow sphere inside a rock mesh to make the meteor. Add a mushroom smoke emitter with upward velocity. Exaggerate: add a screen flash and slow-mo hit-stop for 80 ms.

name: Raiden Musou no Hitotachi

source.title: Genshin Impact - Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu (wiki)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: purple lightning gathers around her, background dims

phases.name: release
phases.what: wide horizontal slash from her sword

phases.name: impact
phases.what: purple arc flash on enemies

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: lightning motes and a purple afterimage

layers.motion: arcs flicker around body, 12 fps jitter
wide crescent sweep 0.2s, width 3, fades quickly
layers.notes: crescent shape is the signature of a slash

whyItLooksGood: crescent trail = clear silhouette
dim background boosts glow
thin white core with purple halo is a strong value ladder
buildNotes: Build the slash as a curved ribbon driven by sword tip positions, and add 2-3 delayed echoes. Exaggerate: triple the trail width, add vertical lightning columns on each enemy, and a quick background darken.

name: Ellen Joe ice ultimate

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: time slows, cold mist and dark vignette

phases.name: release
phases.what: rapid multi-slashes with cyan streaks

phases.name: impact
phases.what: ice burst with shards

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: frost shards drift down, ground frosted

layers.motion: 6 quick slashes crossed at random angles
cold mist low to ground, erosion

whyItLooksGood: crossed straight cuts give a sharp shape
dark vignette boosts cyan
shards give a satisfying end beat
buildNotes: Animate several thin ribbons in quick succession with random angles. Use a brief timeScale dip for hit-stop. Element is ice, mapped to water as the nearest allowed value. Exaggerate: add a final screen-wide cut line and a glass-shatter shard burst.

name: Jiyan aerial thrust

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: green wind swirls around the spear

phases.name: release
phases.what: fast dive along a straight line with a long green streak

phases.name: impact
phases.what: wind burst on target

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: leaves and wind rings dissipate

layers.motion: straight line from start to target, tapering
layers.notes: line is the entire read of a dash

whyItLooksGood: straight ribbon with a clear start and end
ring in the movement plane
cool colour reads as speed
buildNotes: Move the caster mesh with ease-out-quart over 0.3s and leave a ribbon. Exaggerate: add afterimages every 0.04s and longer trail.

name: Moonveil Transient Moonlight

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: sheathed stance, blue glow at the blade

phases.name: release
phases.what: fast draw slash

phases.name: impact
phases.what: crescent wave travels forward

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: blue motes and mist remain

layers.motion: small glow at the blade tip

layers.notes: thin and sharp vs the heavy blast
crescent shape is the iconic read

whyItLooksGood: contrast between thin slash and wide wave
cool blue with white core
simple but strong crescent silhouette
buildNotes: Make the crescent by clipping a ring geometry to 90 degrees. Exaggerate: double the wave size and let it leave light trails on the floor.

name: Arc lightning chain

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: blue sparks at the hand

phases.name: release
phases.what: bolt leaves hand to first target

phases.name: impact
phases.what: bolt hops between enemies with small flashes

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: residual sparks

layers.motion: jagged line, re-roll every 2 frames, 5-9 segments

whyItLooksGood: hop delay gives readable order
jagged bolts re-randomized read as electricity
flash on each target confirms hit
buildNotes: Create bolts with midpoint displacement. Pick targets by distance and cap hops to chain range. Exaggerate: forks at each hop and a thick glow bolt under the thin white core.

name: Kafka Twilight Trill

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: camera cut, purple threads draw across the scene

phases.name: release
phases.what: threads lash to every enemy

phases.name: impact
phases.what: purple-pink electric blast on all enemies

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: shock status sparks remain on enemies

layers.motion: thin curved strands to each enemy
persistent small sparks on each enemy

whyItLooksGood: dark scene lifts purple glow
many curved lines = multi-target at a glance
persistent sparks communicate shock status
buildNotes: Make curved strands with Catmull-Rom curves and animated draw-in. Exaggerate: add a full-screen sweep of strands and heavier lightning on each hit.

name: Yae Miko Tenko Thunderbolts

source.title: Genshin Impact - Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin (wiki)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: pink-purple sigil around Yae, sakura totems glow

phases.name: release
phases.what: totems turn into lightning rods

phases.name: impact
phases.what: huge lightning bolts strike enemies near each totem

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: sparks and petals fade

layers.motion: vertical bolts from the sky, thick, fork

whyItLooksGood: pink petals + purple bolts is distinctive
vertical bolts give clear vertical read
repeated strikes make a rhythm
buildNotes: Spawn bolts with offsets of 0.05-0.1s between strikes. Exaggerate: wider bolts, bolt afterglow line for 0.5s, and a falling petal emitter.

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: frost gathers at hand

phases.name: release
phases.what: slow orb travels forward, spraying shards

phases.name: impact
phases.what: orb bursts into ice explosion

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: frost mist and shards fall

whyItLooksGood: orb silhouette plus shards is simple and bold
cool white to deep blue ladder
shard spray shows what it hits

phases.what: fire swirls at the hand

phases.name: release
phases.what: fireball flies with a flame tail

phases.name: impact

phases.what: smoke and embers

name: Founding Rain of Stars

source.title: Elden Ring - Founding Rain of Stars (wiki)

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: dark cloud forms above target, stars glint

phases.name: release
phases.what: many star bolts rain down

phases.name: impact
phases.what: each star pops with small flash

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: cloud dissipates, motes fall

layers.notes: dark cloud gives backdrop for glow

phases.what: long wind-up, blue magic circle and orbs gather in front of the staff

phases.name: release

phases.name: impact

phases.name: aftermath

thick core with wide glow shell, noise scroll

continuous impact glow

phases.what: dark violet energy swirls around the scythe

phases.name: release
phases.what: wide scythe sweeps with trailing arcs

phases.name: impact

phases.name: aftermath
